# QueryPlanStatistics

- Namespace: `PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`
- Kind: Class

## Summary

Mutable statistics collected during plan execution.
Thread-safe for parallel node execution via Interlocked operations.
